brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: Pair A: piece:0,-1,0 and piece:0,0,0, bolted with jointBolt:0#0,-1#5. Pair B: piece:1,0,0 and piece:2,0,0, bolted with jointBolt:0#1,0#0. No base in one pair touches the other pair except at the single wall between (0,0) and (1,0).

requirements.requirement: Pairs joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: The wall between (0,0) and (1,0) is the only one where the pairs meet. A double side connector (connector:0#0,0|1,0) joins it and it has no joint bolt: the joint-bolt sockets for that wall are still empty, and lockJoints was left out on purpose.

finish.summary: I built four full bases at level 0 as two pairs. Pair A is cells (0,-1) and (0,0), and the two bases are bolted together with jointBolt:0#0,-1#5. Pair B is cells (1,0) and (2,0), bolted together with jointBolt:0#1,0#0. The only place the pairs touch is the wall between (0,0) and (1,0). A double side connector (connector:0#0,0|1,0) joins them there, and that wall has no joint bolt. At first I put a bolt on that wall by mistake, but I removed it and moved it to the wall inside pair B. I capped the open faces with 18 solid end caps. I left out the usual lockJoints step because it would have bolted the wall between the pairs too. The final check found no problems and no mesh clashes.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
